title: Utilization of SAME Data for Advanced Modeling and Simulation of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
scientific_focus: Smoke aerosol dynamics and transport; numerical simulations
objectives: Use SAME-derived smoke-generation conditions to explain particle growth, settling, thermophoresis, and transport differences between Earth gravity and microgravity.
approach: Model dibutyl phthalate (DBP) smoke aerosols originating from a heated sample using direct numerical simulation with a Navier–Stokes nodal formulation. Compare two low-speed crossflow cases under buoyant and nonbuoyant conditions; examine how wake geometry and flow affect particle accumulation and size distributions.
